hypotheses.name: Non-operating-income reliance/volatility (forensic earnings-composition penalty)
hypotheses.manager_source: Marcellus -- 12-ratio Schilit-based forensic framework, income-statement-manipulation check #2
hypotheses.quote: [DATA] "volatility in non-operating income" -- Shreyas_Ionic_AMC/04_RND_LAB/PMS_STUDY_20260712/notes_marcellus.md L45 (item 9, income-statement checks, sub-item 2)
hypotheses.construction_exact: [INFERENCE -- source names the ratio, not the exact formula/threshold] From ALPHA_RANKER/data/fundamentals/MASTER_fundamentals_pit.parquet (long-format, metric_norm='other income' vs metric_norm='profit before tax', joined PIT on available_date): compute other_income_share_t = other_income_t / profit_before_tax_t per quarter, then trailing-8Q stdev(other_income_share) AND trailing-8Q mean(other_income_share). High LEVEL (PAT propped up by non-core income) and/or high VOLATILITY (one-off gains smoothing) both penalize. Score = -1 * z(trailing_mean_share) - 1 * z(trailing_stdev_share), cross-sectional rank.
hypotheses.expected_sign: -  (high/volatile non-operating income share -> lower forward return; earnings quality red flag, treated as a gate/penalty per FRAMEWORK_CATALOG SS8 convention, not linear alpha)
data_assets: ALPHA_RANKER/data/fundamentals/MASTER_fundamentals_pit.parquet (metric_norm: 'other income' n=49352, 'profit before tax' n=49352 -- near-full coverage, PIT available_date present)
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7_legs: [INFERENCE, needs empirical corr<0.6 gate before promotion] Distinct MECHANISM from the existing CFO/PAT-authenticity leg (that leg tests cash-vs-accrual divergence at the PAT level; this tests earnings COMPOSITION -- how much of PBT is core-operating vs one-off/non-operating). Zero overlap by construction with EY (price-based), momentum, MA-65 (price-based), net-share-issuance (equity capital field), asset-growth (total assets field), QMJ (op_profit/total_assets, 3y net-profit CAGR, beta, dividend_payout% -- different fields entirely). Must still clear the standing orthogonality gate (corr<0.6 AND delta-IC_IR>0) vs CFO/PAT specifically before any promotion, per FINAL_MODEL.md SS1 discipline.
hypotheses.money_rationale: Captures a genuinely different fraud/earnings-management tell than anything in the current forensic stack: a company beating estimates on a volatile 'other income' line (treasury gains, forex, asset sales) rather than core operations is a classic pre-blowup pattern (matches ANALYST_CHECKLISTS.md red-flag philosophy) that CFO/PAT alone would miss if the non-operating item is itself cash (e.g. a one-off asset sale hits both PAT and CFO in the same period).
hypotheses.priority: medium-high -- one clean test: incremental IC_IR of this penalty over CANONICAL_7LEG_1Y residual, lag+placebo gate, corr-vs-CFO/PAT<0.6 gate before scoring further

hypotheses.name: Reserves-roll-forward reconciliation gap (forensic 'hidden P&L' penalty)
hypotheses.manager_source: Marcellus -- 12-ratio Schilit-based forensic framework, balance-sheet check #6
hypotheses.quote: [DATA] "change in reserves explained by P&L for the year + dividends (i.e., does the reserves roll-forward reconcile)" -- notes_marcellus.md L46 (item 9, balance-sheet checks, sub-item 6)
hypotheses.construction_exact: [INFERENCE -- source names the ratio, not the exact formula/threshold] From MASTER_fundamentals_pit.parquet: expected_delta_reserves_t = net_profit_t - dividend_payout_t (dividend_payout% x net_profit_t where dividend_payout% is available, n=7695/49355 ~15.6% coverage; ELSE approximate dividend=0, flagged as added noise for the ~84% of rows without disclosed payout -- an explicit [INFERENCE] approximation, not silent). actual_delta_reserves_t = reserves_t - reserves_t-1 (available n=49277, near-full). gap_t = (actual_delta_reserves_t - expected_delta_reserves_t) / abs(reserves_t-1). Large |gap| (either direction) = penalty: flags write-offs, revaluation/FCTR reserve movements, or other equity adjustments bypassing the P&L that a simple net-profit/EY screen cannot see.
hypotheses.expected_sign: -  (large unexplained reserves-roll-forward gap -> lower forward return / forensic penalty, not linear alpha)
data_assets: ALPHA_RANKER/data/fundamentals/MASTER_fundamentals_pit.parquet (metric_norm: 'reserves' n=49277, 'net profit' n=49352, 'dividend payout %' n=7695 sparse -- coverage caveat must ship with the card, same sparsity pattern already disclosed for promoter-buying data)
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7_legs: [INFERENCE, needs empirical corr<0.6 gate] Distinct from asset-growth (total-assets side of balance sheet, not reserves/equity side) and from CFO/PAT (cash-flow-statement vs balance-sheet-equity reconciliation -- different statement, different mechanism). Zero field overlap with EY/momentum/MA-65/net-share-issuance/QMJ's specific inputs.
hypotheses.money_rationale: A genuine 'hidden P&L' forensic tell distinct from every existing forensic factor on file (Beneish/Montier/CFO-PAT/receivables-inventory/CWIP/pledge/auditor/RPT/covenant/key-mgmt-churn per FRAMEWORK_CATALOG SS8) -- catches equity-side manipulation (asset revaluations, forex translation reserve games, write-offs routed around the P&L) that income-statement-only forensic checks structurally cannot see.
hypotheses.priority: medium -- coverage caveat (sparse dividend field) means this should run as a DIRECTIONAL/penalty-only test first, not a scored leg; kill if it fails lag/placebo or if corr to CFO/PAT >=0.6

hypotheses.name: Cyclical-sector normalized (multi-year-average) earnings yield
hypotheses.manager_source: Aequitas (explicit 'earnings at bottom of cycle' framing) + Buoyant Satellite sleeve (metals/CV/NBFC turnaround-cyclicals thesis) -- convergent cyclicals-specific value logic
hypotheses.quote: [DATA] "Sector-cyclicality-adjusted earnings ('earnings at bottom of cycle')... could proxy with multi-year normalized/average EPS instead of TTM, but this is a judgment call not a hard rule" -- notes_aequitas.md L124. Corroborating: "Satellite sleeve criteria: cyclical sectors named explicitly (metals, commercial vehicles, NBFCs)... 'leaders that look expensive but offer asymmetric upside'" -- notes_buoyant.md L37
hypotheses.construction_exact: [INFERENCE -- notes_aequitas.md itself flags this as a judgment call, not a documented formula; this is our own defensible codable proxy, stated as such] Within cyclical sectors only (metals/mining, autos/CV, capital goods, cement, NBFC -- via sector_map.parquet tags), compute normalized_EY_t = (trailing 5-7yr AVERAGE eps-in-rs, PIT-available at each point) / price_t, vs the standard TTM-EPS-based EY already in the 7-leg composite. Test cross-sectional IC of normalized_EY WITHIN the cyclical-sector subset only, incremental over the existing EY leg's IC in that same subset (does cycle-normalization improve the value signal specifically where earnings are most volatile/cycle-peaked?).
hypotheses.expected_sign: + (cheap on cycle-normalized earnings = value opportunity ahead of an earnings-cycle upturn; TTM-EY can misprice cyclicals as 'cheap' right at peak earnings -- a known value-trap failure mode TTM-EY does not correct for)
data_assets: MASTER_fundamentals_pit.parquet (metric_norm='eps in rs', n=48267, near-full coverage, multi-year history available per company)
ALPHA_RANKER/rnd/lib/sector_map.py / sector_map.parquet (sector tagging for the cyclical subset)
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7_legs: [INFERENCE, needs empirical test] This is explicitly a CONDITIONAL REFINEMENT of the existing EY leg (same underlying EPS/price field), not a new independent bet -- expected corr to EY likely high OUTSIDE the cyclical subset (by construction, near-identical when earnings are stable) but should diverge meaningfully INSIDE it. Per house doctrine (DCF/market-state/smallcap-tier were all folded into EY at 0.74-1.00 corr, not kept separate), this must clear an incremental-IC-over-EY-within-subset bar specifically, not a standalone promotion -- test it the way DCF was tested, not the way a new leg is tested.
hypotheses.money_rationale: Directly targets the exact value-trap failure mode multiple managers flag for cyclicals (buying 'cheap TTM P/E' right at a margin/earnings peak) -- if it clears the incremental bar within the cyclical subset, it is a sector-conditional improvement to the anchor leg (EY) rather than a new independent bet, consistent with how DCF/market-state were already integrated.
hypotheses.priority: medium -- cheapest test: incremental IC of normalized-EY over EY, cyclical-sector subset only, one-day-lag + placebo; kill if incremental IC is not clearly positive or if subset sample size is too thin for a stable IC

hypotheses.name: Within-sector market-cap leadership (industry-leader-not-challenger)
hypotheses.quote: [DATA] "Core sleeve criteria: predictable cash flows, preference for dividend yield over uncertain growth, industry leaders (not challengers)" -- notes_buoyant.md L36. Codability note: "'Industry leader not challenger': roughly proxy via market-cap rank within sector/sub-sector (top 1-2 by market cap) -- codable if we have a sector classification map for NIFTY500" -- notes_buoyant.md L88
hypotheses.construction_exact: [INFERENCE -- source gives the concept and a codability sketch, not an exact formula] Using sector_map.parquet, compute within_sector_mktcap_rank_t = percentile rank of mktcap_log WITHIN the stock's own sector/sub-sector at date t (distinct from mktcap_log's UNIVERSE-WIDE rank, which is the already-tested/killed-then-recovered size factor H028). Score = being top-1/top-2 (or top decile) by market cap WITHIN one's own sector, not in the whole NIFTY500 cross-section.
hypotheses.expected_sign: + (within-sector leadership -> durable pricing power/moat/scale advantage -> higher forward return), though this must be tested against the alternative hypothesis that it is just a repackaged size effect
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7_legs: [INFERENCE, must be tested explicitly] Primary risk: this may just be H028 (size, already tested, signed IC_IR recovered as strongly negative-raw/positive-signed per SURVIVORS.md) re-expressed within-sector. MANDATORY first test before anything else: corr(within_sector_mktcap_rank, universe_wide_mktcap_rank) -- if >=0.6, this is not a new bet and should be parked immediately (same logic CONSOLIDATION already applied to reject 'sector-neutral' as adding nothing beyond the composite per H048). Only proceed to an IC test if the correlation gate is cleared.
hypotheses.money_rationale: If genuinely distinct from raw size (i.e., a small-in-absolute-terms but dominant-in-its-niche company scores differently from a similarly-small company in a fragmented sector), this captures competitive-moat/pricing-power information that neither the universe-wide size factor nor QMJ's profitability/safety/payout composite directly measures.
hypotheses.priority: low-medium -- CHEAPEST possible test is the orthogonality-vs-H028 correlation check FIRST (near-zero cost); only spend an IC-test slot if that gate clears, per the wave's own DO-NOT-DO discipline against redundant 'new' factors
